description: Card R-ORACLE-1 OR-WIRE (3m35): ByRef forms of DAO Workspace.CommitTrans(Options) and DBEngine.CommitTrans(Options) on ACCDB (same fixture and setup as r-txn-1b/commit-option-vartypes, writable OpenDatabase in Workspaces(0)). Workspace.CommitTrans asks every VarType admitted by value: I4 1, I2 1, UI1 1, Bool True, R8 1.0, BSTR '1' (each as VT_BYREF|<T> and VT_BYREF|VT_VARIANT), plus Empty and Null (as VT_BYREF|VT_VARIANT); DBEngine.CommitTrans asks I4 1 (VT_BYREF|VT_I4 and VT_BYREF|VT_VARIANT). Each step wraps BeginTrans, UPDATE Lv SET V = V + 1 WHERE ID = 1, CommitTrans(arg), DBEngine.Errors, Rollback, DBEngine.Errors and reads SUM(V) from Lv. Asks whether each ByRef form answers identically to its by-value form.
